verdict.rationale: Supermemory documents outbound real-time webhooks for its connectors (Google Drive, Gmail, Notion, OneDrive, GitHub auto-sync), showing webhook-based event infrastructure exists, but there's no documented mechanism for a user/developer to subscribe their own endpoint to Supermemory's internal events (e.g., memory-created, ingestion-complete) as a general webhook subscription API. Missing for 10: a documented outbound webhook subscription API/endpoint for arbitrary events (memory added, search performed, etc.), configuration docs for registering a callback URL, and independent confirmation of this working end-to-end.
